__doc__: Fragment to MERGE into the mission RUNTIME-config (the integration lane's transfer1 executor staging config -- the one carrying arm_stiffness_abs/arm_damping_abs/arm_max_effort/arm_gravity_ff, NOT the host config) to fix the executor LOADED pick's ur_shoulder_lift shortfall (sim-robust-executor-shoulder-sag-v1). In execretest (PR 214) the moving-arm executor pick reached 5 of 6 joints to ~1e-5 rad but ur_shoulder_lift settled 0.098 rad (5.6 deg) short -> TRAJ_HOST_GOAL_MISS -> TRAJ_HOST_FAULT 'measured goal tolerance not reached'. CPU torque balance (data/sim-robust-executor-shoulder-sag-v1/report.md) showed the gravity feedforward was evaluated at the COMMANDED (goal) pose while the arm physically lagged at the measured pose (over-compensation), AND the 0.45 kg welded carton was omitted from the FF mass model; on the soft shoulder_lift joint the ~1 Nm residual the two leave gives the miss. 'arm_gravity_ff_loaded_carry': true evaluates the robot gravity at the MEASURED arm config and adds the carried carton's gravity (held-gated on the gripper latch), which together drive the terminal net torque to ~0 so the arm REACHES the goal on every joint -- the goal tolerance stays tight at 0.010 rad (no loosening). payload mass defaults to the scenario handling_unit.mass_kg (0.45); the two overrides below are OPTIONAL and shown only for completeness. DEFAULT OFF everywhere: absent arm_gravity_ff_loaded_carry => byte-identical to the legacy FF (commanded-pose, no payload). Keep the rest of the transfer1 executor staging UNCHANGED. Bounded GPU proof: run the same transfer1 executor staging with this key added; PASS = the pick reaches its goal (no TRAJ_HOST_GOAL_MISS on shoulder_lift) and the transfer proceeds past the pick.
